_README: 85 unmodified official assets and three privacy-cropped official derivatives. The derivative records bind source and output bytes to the accompanying crop recipe. No added annotation callouts are claimed. Further annotation/zoom polishing is deferred.

official-033-github-code-review.png.reason: Cropped out credential-like example code while preserving the review finding and its qualification that detection does not verify a live credential. Final crop personally inspected; no callouts added.

official-048-agent-investigation.png.reason: Cropped browser tabs and session-like address chrome from the official Agent 365 plugin demonstration. The inventory, risk/status/action columns and plugin remain visible. Final crop personally inspected; no callouts added.

official-086-purview.png.reason: Cropped browser/session chrome from Microsoft's synthetic-data DLP demonstration, retaining the stopped agent and policy toast. FFmpeg chroma alignment removes one extra edge pixel. Final crop personally inspected; no callouts added.

chat-to-cowork.png.reason: Microsoft's unmodified chat-to-Cowork illustration already identifies both choices; adding our callouts would alter official artwork.

office.gif.reason: Microsoft's unmodified Office animation contains changing product UI; static callouts would misidentify controls across frames.

today.gif.reason: Microsoft's unmodified Today animation illustrates suggested-work cards; no added callouts or tenant-capture claim.

workspaces.png.reason: Microsoft's unmodified Workspace illustration already shows its activity, conversation and content regions; retained without our overlays.

projects.png.reason: Microsoft's unmodified Projects illustration retains the original tab labels and prompt; no additional annotation is needed to distinguish it from Workspaces.

autopilot.png.reason: Microsoft's unmodified Autopilot illustration retains its Frontier badge and conversation; no overlay should imply a completed real-world action.

work-iq-1.png.reason: Microsoft's unmodified labeled Work IQ concept diagram is explanatory artwork, not a screenshot requiring control callouts.
